task_meta.title: Improve an ugly, inaccessible signup form

judge.reasons: Calm centred card with visible labels, hint text, a dominant full-width button, tall inputs and a clean 390px layout. Error, submitting and success states and ARIA wiring can't be seen in the screenshots, so they're unverified.

claim_text:
I've redesigned the signup page and tested it in headless Chrome. It works and looks right on a 390px phone, on desktop, and in dark mode, with no sideways scrolling even at 320px.

**What I tested (all passed):**
- **Labels and errors:** every field has a `<label for>` and no pl
digest: Read 7 files (1 before its first edit), made 3 edits, ran tests 2 times; re-ran them after its last edit.
